quirks.name: Dark Temptation
quirks.effectDescription: Increases stress gain by 15% when entering a new room.

quirks.name: Runic Obsession
quirks.effectDescription: Grants a 5% chance to ignore a critical hit on allies.

quirks.name: Fear of the Dark
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces accuracy by 10% in unlit chambers.

quirks.name: Unyielding Spine
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces incoming damage by 5% when health is below 30%.

quirks.name: Mournful Lament
quirks.effectDescription: Allies within 2 tiles suffer a -5% morale penalty.

quirks.name: Eldritch Curiosity
quirks.effectDescription: Gain a 10% boost to discovery chances on treasure chests.

quirks.name: Bloodied Hands
quirks.effectDescription: Increases bleed damage taken by 20%.

quirks.name: Silent Resolve
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces stress gain from enemy taunts by 25%.

quirks.name: Cursed Birthright
quirks.effectDescription: All healing effects are reduced by 10%.

quirks.name: Ashen Heart
quirks.effectDescription: Grants a 5% increase to fire resistance.

quirks.name: Gloomwalker
quirks.effectDescription: Movement speed reduced by 10% in bright light.

quirks.name: Hallowed Vow
quirks.effectDescription: Once per battle, can fully restore a single ally's morale.

quirks.name: Ravenous Appetite
quirks.effectDescription: Consumes 5% extra food each turn.

quirks.name: Stonebound Will
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces stun duration by 50%.

quirks.name: Wraithlike Presence
quirks.effectDescription: All enemies have a 5% chance to miss when targeting this character.

quirks.name: Bleak Prognostication
quirks.effectDescription: Increases chance of random events triggering negative outcomes by 10%.

quirks.name: Sanguine Pact
quirks.effectDescription: Whenever you deal damage, you lose 2% of max health.

quirks.name: Iron Discipline
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces stress gain from long battles by 20%.

quirks.name: Echoes of Madness
quirks.effectDescription: Periodically (every 3 turns) you act twice in a row, consuming extra stamina.

quirks.name: Divine Scars
quirks.effectDescription: Grants a flat +2 to all saving throws.

quirks.name: Nightmare Vision
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces perception, causing a -15% chance to detect hidden traps.

quirks.name: Grim Determination
quirks.effectDescription: When below 20% health, gain a 10% damage boost.

quirks.name: Soulbound Relic
quirks.effectDescription: Once per expedition, automatically revive with 30% health.

quirks.name: Pale Hunger
quirks.effectDescription: Increases hunger rate by 15%.

quirks.name: Twisted Faith
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces the effectiveness of holy abilities by 20%.

quirks.name: Veil of Shadows
quirks.effectDescription: Allies gain a 5% dodge bonus while standing next to you.

quirks.name: Obsidian Resolve
quirks.effectDescription: Reduces critical hit damage taken by 10%.

quirks.name: Maddening Echo
quirks.effectDescription: Every turn, a random ally gains +5% stress.

quirks.name: Harbinger's Gaze
quirks.effectDescription: Increases chance to predict enemy actions by 8%.

quirks.name: Cursed Echo
quirks.effectDescription: Whenever you heal, you also receive 5% of that healing as damage.

afflictions.name: Paranoia
afflictions.barkQuote: I can feel eyes watching us from the walls!

afflictions.name: Masochism
afflictions.barkQuote: Pain sharpens my mind; let the blows rain!

afflictions.name: Hopelessness
afflictions.barkQuote: What good is fighting when the darkness never ends?

afflictions.name: Abusive
afflictions.barkQuote: You're all useless! I could do better alone!

afflictions.name: Irrational
afflictions.barkQuote: The walls are breathing! We must flee!

afflictions.name: Fearful
afflictions.barkQuote: Every shadow could be our doom!

afflictions.name: Despair
afflictions.barkQuote: All hope is lost; why even try?

afflictions.name: Hysterical Laughter
afflictions.barkQuote: Hehehe... the abyss laughs with us!

afflictions.name: Stagnant Mind
afflictions.barkQuote: My thoughts are heavy as stone.

virtues.name: Courage
virtues.barkQuote: Stand firm! The night cannot break us!

virtues.name: Fortitude
virtues.barkQuote: I will endure whatever this darkness hurls!

virtues.name: Focus
virtues.barkQuote: My mind is clear; my blade finds its mark.

virtues.name: Vigorous
virtues.barkQuote: Feel the surge of life within me!

virtues.name: Powerful
virtues.barkQuote: Let my strength shatter the shadows!
